score_refusal.reason: These artifacts are derived from Epoch AI's PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVE SAMPLE TRANSCRIPTS (5 published sample problems). They are NOT the FrontierMath benchmark. FrontierMath is a private held-out problem set that is not distributed. No number computed from these samples is a FrontierMath score, an approximation of one, or a lower/upper bound on one. The sample corpus contains no ground-truth answers and no grader verdicts.
score_refusal.not_a_substitute: GSM8K, MATH / MATH-500, MathArena, AIME sets, and any other public math benchmark are NOT substitutes for FrontierMath. A score on any of them is not a FrontierMath score.

public_sample_asset.artifact_disclaimer: These artifacts are derived from Epoch AI's PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVE SAMPLE TRANSCRIPTS (5 published sample problems). They are NOT the FrontierMath benchmark. FrontierMath is a private held-out problem set that is not distributed. No number computed from these samples is a FrontierMath score, an approximation of one, or a lower/upper bound on one. gradability.gradable_locally_reason: The public sample corpus carries no ground-truth answers and no grader verdicts. Correctness cannot be computed. Even with ground truth, five published sample problems are not the FrontierMath benchmark.

blockers: TERMINAL — the dataset is never released. Epoch AI is contractually unable to share Tiers 1-4 questions and answers without OpenAI's written permission. There is no download, no gated Hugging Face repo, no data-use agreement, and no request form that yields the problems. No local action can ever unblock this lane.

Evaluation is HOSTED BY EPOCH AI, not submitted to a portal. A FrontierMath number requires Epoch to run the eval on their own infrastructure against a model they can reach (public API, pre-release access, or a UI session their staff drive). This is an organisational agreement, not a credential this repo can set.
No grader is public. Reference solutions and the answer-checking logic ship with the private set. The public transcripts contain neither ground truth nor verdicts, so nothing here is gradable.

The public sample corpus (150 transcripts over the ORIGINAL 5 public problems from the 2024 paper) is characterization evidence only. It is ~1.5% of the 338-problem post-v2 private set, is outdated relative to the 12 problems Epoch currently publishes, and is not a benchmark split.

No official FrontierMath dataset exists on Hugging Face or GitHub. Every repo claiming to be FrontierMath is a solver or a reconstruction and cannot produce a comparable score. Using one would be fabrication.
Any local math result (GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME, MathArena) is a different benchmark and must never be reported under frontiermath_eval.
